expectedBehaviors.contract: start() is a no-op when window is undefined.
invariants: SSR imports must not require DOM execution.

expectedBehaviors.contract: register(name, module, dependencies) stores component metadata globally by name.
invariants: customElements.define is called only if the name is not already defined.

expectedBehaviors.contract: component roots receive tplid and compiled render functions before mount.
initial state merges scope, model, and html-model, with html-model winning.
invariants: functional model receives elm, initialState, dependencies

expectedBehaviors.contract: state.set schedules render and morphs the component root.
invariants: multiple rapid sets are debounced by tick

expectedBehaviors.contract: failed directive expressions render as empty string.
invariants: null and undefined become empty string

expectedBehaviors.contract: parent morphing skips child component roots and forwards state separately.
invariants: child protected keys are not overwritten
child scope is stored before update

expectedBehaviors.contract: nodes with html-static are not morphed.
invariants: descendant DOM remains under external ownership

expectedBehaviors.contract: on(event, selector, callback) listens from component root and sets delegateTarget.
invariants: focus, blur, mouseenter, and mouseleave use capture

expectedBehaviors.contract: on('[attr]', selector?, callback) observes attribute changes within the component root.
connectedCallback creates an AbortController and dispatches :mount after Component setup.
subscribe receives future publishes and immediately receives cached data for previously published topics.
invariants: object payloads are shallow-merged in cache

edgeCases: state.set does nothing if the component node is no longer in document.body.
dataset parses true, false, numbers, JavaScript expressions, JSON, then falls back to string.
html-for uses for...in, so array-like order is best represented by arrays.
html-model is executed as JavaScript and must not contain untrusted input.
template tags are unwrapped unless they carry html-if or html-inner.
failureConditions: Missing registered component name means no custom element class is defined for that tag.
Invalid directive expressions silently render fallback empty strings.
Third-party DOM without html-static can be changed by morphing.
Global pub/sub subscriptions leak unless unsubscribed on unmount.
